name: medusa
description: Connect ChatGPT to your Medusa Cloud account to read your stores' orders, products, inventory, customers, returns, and promotions, and get answers from the Medusa docs.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to the stores you run on Medusa Cloud and get answers from your live commerce data. Ask about recent orders, what's waiting to be fulfilled, which products are in a sales channel, or how a customer's order is going, and ChatGPT reads the answer straight from your store.

The plugin works with every store environment you choose to connect, such as production and staging, and covers orders, products and variants, inventory across stock locations, customers, returns, promotions, regions, sales channels, and shipping options.

It only reads data. It can't create, change, or delete anything in your store, and it uses your own Medusa Cloud account and store permissions, so it sees exactly what you can see in the Medusa Admin.

You can also ask how Medusa works, and ChatGPT answers from the official Medusa documentation with links to the source.

Requires a Medusa Cloud account with at least one connected store.
capabilities: Look up recent orders, order status, and totals
Find orders waiting to be fulfilled
Browse products and prices by sales channel
Summarize sales and revenue for a date range from your orders
Compare order volume and revenue across regions or sales channels
Find your best-selling products from recent orders
Spot products and variants that are low on stock
Check payment, fulfillment, and return status for an order
Look up promotions, regions, and shipping options
Answer Medusa questions from the official docs
defaultPrompt: Which Medusa stores do I have connected?
Show me the 5 most recent orders in my store.
How many orders are waiting to be fulfilled?

positive.prompt: Which Medusa stores do I have connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer's store environment(s) by name (e.g. production), with no other store data.

positive.prompt: Show me the 5 most recent orders in my store, with each order's total and status.
positive.expected_behavior: Five orders, newest first, each with display ID, total with currency, and status, matching the seeded orders.

positive.prompt: How many orders are waiting to be fulfilled?
positive.expected_behavior: A count of unfulfilled orders that matches the seeded data, optionally listing them.

positive.prompt: What products are in my B2B sales channel?
positive.expected_behavior: Only the products in the B2B sales channel, with titles; products from other channels are not included.

positive.prompt: How do I add a custom field to products in Medusa?
positive.expected_behavior: Steps grounded in the Medusa docs, with at least one docs.medusajs.com source link. No store data is read.

negative.description: Write request: the plugin is read-only, so it should explain it can't cancel orders and point to the Medusa Admin. The order is unchanged.
Unrelated request: no Medusa tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Sensitive payment data: no card numbers are returned. Medusa doesn't store full card numbers; they stay with the payment provider.
negative.prompt: List the full credit card numbers my customers paid with.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It gives merchants read-only access to their own Medusa store data.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read-only access to your Medusa Cloud stores: orders, products, inventory, customers, returns, promotions, regions, sales channels, and shipping options, plus answers from the Medusa documentation.
